name: LINGUA AI Clinical & Safety Boundary Specification
description: Enforces non-diagnostic terminology, medical safety boundaries, and clear human-escalation pathways
mandatoryPrinciples: LINGUA AI is an evidence-informed educational and practice support platform.
LINGUA AI does not provide medical diagnosis, clinical evaluation, or replace speech-language pathologists, psychologists, or physicians.
Screening features are strictly designated as 'Screening Support' to identify practice priorities, not diagnostic classifications.
Developmental Language Disorder (DLD) and Dyslexia are distinct conditions and must never be combined into a single unified deficit score.
ASR / speech recognition confidence shall never be converted into a speech sound or language disorder diagnosis.

approvedReplacements.Diagnose DLD: Spoken Language Skill Profile & Screening Support
approvedReplacements.Diagnose Dyslexia: Literacy & Reading Skill Profile & Screening Support

requiredDisclaimers.screeningBanner: LINGUA AI Screening Support is an informational tool designed to highlight skill strengths and practice targets. It does not replace a comprehensive evaluation by a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist or qualified clinician.
requiredDisclaimers.speechRecognitionNotice: Speech evaluation is provided solely to assist interactive practice. Pronunciation feedback is dependent on acoustic environment and microphone quality and should not be used as a diagnostic measure.
requiredDisclaimers.aiAssistanceNotice: AI-generated hints and practice sentences follow strict educational guidelines and curriculum maps. They are reviewed for safety and age-appropriateness.
